Theatre Information

Wyndham's Theatre
Charing Cross Road,
London, WC2H 0DA

Get Directions

Our theatre box offices open from 2 hours and 30 minutes before the start of the show, until 15 minutes after curtain up. On matinee days the box office remains open in between performances.

Please allow plenty of time to find the theatre. For everyone's safety we carry out security and bag checks on arrival. Latecomers may not be admitted until a suitable break in the performance.

By train or underground: the nearest train station is Charing Cross and the nearest tube station is Leicester Square.

By bus: the nearest bus stops are serviced by numbers 24, 29, 176.

By car: take advantage of the Q-Park Theatreland parking scheme with 50% off car parking after midday for up to four hours. There is also parking available at MasterPark at Cambridge Circus (150m) and NCP at Bedfordbury and Upper St Martin's Lane.

For information on hearing enhancement aids, assistance dogs, and assisted performances at Delfont Mackintosh Theatres, including captioned, audio described and BSL interpreted performances, visit our Access hub.

If you have any questions relating to access, please contact our Customer Service Team on 0344 482 5137† or email access@delfontmackintosh.co.uk.

Access hosts are available should you need assistance during your visit. Please ask on arrival.

Accessible parking:
The theatre itself has no parking facilities but there are disabled bays nearby on St Martin's Lane or Charing Cross Road. For more information visit the City of Westminster website.

Accessible toilets:
There is one accessible toilet to the rear of the Stalls, best accessed via seats in Stalls Box A.
Access to the Ladies toilets from the foyer are up 8 steps with a further 2 steps down inside. There is a Gentlemen's non-adapted toilet, accessed via St Martin's Court at street level and down 1 step. Access to the auditorium from this toilet is down an additional 8 steps - please ask theatre staff for assistance.

Step Access:
Seats in the auditorium can be accessed via the number of steps listed below:
• Stalls: 18 steps
• Royal Circle: 18 steps
• Grand Circle: 40 steps to Row A-D and 56 steps to Row E-H
• Royal Circle Box: 21 steps
• Grand Circle Box: 40 steps

Wheelchairs:
Wheelchair access is available only into Box A of the Stalls via a wheelchair lift. The theatre can accommodate standard size electric wheelchairs, and the lift can accommodate up to 500kg in weight. The lift is 46 x 31 inches.
We set aside seating for wheelchair users so please get in touch before booking.

View Wyndham's Theatre seating plan which also indicates the location of facilities.

Bars:
With doors opening 45 minutes prior to the performance, arrive early to allow yourself time to clear security and enjoy a drink before the show. There are three licensed bars in the theatre.

Please note that you may not bring food or drink purchased elsewhere into our theatres.

All our theatre bars serve drinks and snacks, but not hot food. Our theatres sell products which may contain allergens. Allergen information is available upon request from all bars or other staff selling refreshments around the venue.

Cloakroom:

For a small fee (free for DMT+ members) cloakrooms are available to store items during the performance (subject to space). As cloakroom space is limited, please contact Stasher before your visit for larger items (using coupon code SHOWTIMESTASH to receive a discount).

Lithium-polymer and lithium-ion batteries, for example batteries for electric bikes, may only be stored in the cloakroom in a fireproof bag. Please note, bikes cannot be stored inside our premises.

Lost property:
If you have any enquiries regarding lost property please email customer services. Lost property will be kept at the theatre for one month.

Toilets:
There are toilets on all levels.
